title: Repeated Crisis Care Hold on Inpatient Closures, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Repeated crisis care keeps days back from the release when the cancellation of an approved Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Prime is confirmed under **Referrals and Authorizations**, because a patient in a run of emergency visits is the one most likely to need another short admission.

> **Clause.** Where three or more emergency department visits of the patient are dated in the last month, two days are held; where exactly two are, one day is held; otherwise nothing is held.

The visits counted are the emergency department visits of the patient on the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines dated in the last month.

| Emergency department visits dated in the last month | Days held from the release |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2 |
| exactly 2 | 1 |
| 1 or none | 0 |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A patient whose TRICARE Prime lines show emergency visits on three dates in the last month has two days held; had only two of those visits fallen in the last month, one day would be held.
